1482:
WITH consumption_by_year AS (
    SELECT
        c."segment",
        SUBSTRING(ym."date", 1, 4) AS "year",
        SUM(ym."consumption") AS "total_consumption"
    FROM "yearmonth" ym
    JOIN "customers" c ON c."customerid" = ym."customerid"
    WHERE c."currency" = 'EUR'
      AND SUBSTRING(ym."date", 1, 4) IN ('2012', '2013')
      AND c."segment" IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
    GROUP BY c."segment", SUBSTRING(ym."date", 1, 4)
),
pivoted AS (
    SELECT
        "segment",
        SUM(CASE WHEN "year" = '2012' THEN "total_consumption" ELSE 0 END) AS "consumption_2012",
        SUM(CASE WHEN "year" = '2013' THEN "total_consumption" ELSE 0 END) AS "consumption_2013"
    FROM consumption_by_year
    GROUP BY "segment"
),
percentages AS (
    SELECT
        "segment",
        "consumption_2012",
        "consumption_2013",
        ("consumption_2013" - "consumption_2012") AS "increase",
        CASE
            WHEN "consumption_2013" = 0 THEN NULL
            ELSE (("consumption_2013" - "consumption_2012") / "consumption_2013") * 100
        END AS "percentage_increase"
    FROM pivoted
)
